findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/spec-review-pin.js::fold disclosure printed to stdout is not persisted to any artifact in cmdspecreviewpin
findings.title: fold disclosure printed to stdout is not persisted to any artifact in cmdSpecReviewPin
findings.action: persist it via a governor cross-ref (the spec's named capture_last_failure_round extension point), not in this ticket
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's Chosen loudness decision scopes stdout as the cheapest in-band disclosure and says it is not as loud as a governor anomaly; a persisted disclosure is OUT OF SCOPE as the capture_last_failure_round extension point.

findings.disposition_rationale: The sole production caller (cmdSpecReviewPin) validates --round as a positive integer before reaching the catch; the sibling captureNoLensServed takes the same unvalidated internal argument.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/spec-review-pin.js::torn marker beside a pin is fresh-written in capturereadfailure
findings.title: torn marker beside a pin is fresh-written in captureReadFailure
findings.action: none; repair of an unvouchable marker is FAFF-1331
findings.disposition_rationale: A torn marker beside a pin is already unvouchable: readCaptureOutcome returns null, so govern cannot read it as captured before or after this write. The spec's edge-case table routes torn to a fresh write deliberately; repair is FAFF-1331's scope.

occurrences.title: torn marker beside a pin is fresh-written in captureReadFailure

findings.title: non-atomic read-modify-write fold in captureReadFailure
findings.disposition_rationale: Same pattern as the shipped captureNoLensServed fold (FAFF-1323); one capture call per round, and prep's re-dispatch runs after the outaged attempt, not concurrently with it.
